fine_lines.title: usual vs unusual
fine_lines.explanation_ar: usual = معتاد يحدث كثيرًا. unusual = غير معتاد. البادئة un- تقلب المعنى (happy → unhappy).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Usual = normal, happens a lot. Unusual = not normal. The prefix un- makes the opposite (happy → unhappy).

examples.sentence: Eating lunch at noon is usual.

fine_lines.title: always vs never
fine_lines.explanation_ar: always = في كل مرة، never = ولا مرة. يأتيان قبل الفعل الأساسي: I always walk. I never sword fight.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Always = every time; never = not one time. Put them before the main verb: I always walk. I never sword fight.

examples.sentence: I always look for something unusual to do.

fine_lines.title: bored vs boring
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bored تصف شعور الشخص (أنا أشعر بالملل)، boring تصف الشيء المسبب للملل (الفيلم مُمل).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Bored describes how a person feels. Boring describes the thing that makes people feel bored.

expressions.meaning_en: A large celebration of someone's birthday.

expressions.meaning_en: Something I don't usually do, happening today for a reason.

expressions.meaning_en: Some things are normal and some are different.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to speak to a king or queen.

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency: always, never
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نستخدم always و never لنقول كم مرة نفعل شيئًا.
٢) تأتي قبل الفعل الأساسي: I always exercise.
٣) تأتي بعد فعل be: I am never bored.
٤) never منفية بنفسها: I never listen (وليس I don't never listen).
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Always and never tell how often we do something.
2) They go before the main verb: I always exercise.
3) They go after be: I am never bored.
4) Never is negative by itself: I never listen (not I don't never listen).
examples: I always look for something unusual to do.
I never eat lunch at home.
She is always happy on Sunday.

grammar.title: Simple present vs present continuous
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) المضارع البسيط للعادات والأشياء التي تتكرر: I never watch puppet shows.
٢) المضارع المستمر (am/is/are + ing) لما يحدث الآن: Today I am watching a puppet show.
٣) كلمات تساعدك: always / never / every day مع البسيط، و now / today مع المستمر.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Simple present for habits: I never watch puppet shows.
2) Present continuous (am/is/are + -ing) for now: Today I am watching a puppet show.
3) Helpful words: always / never / every day → simple; now / today → continuous.
examples: I never sword fight. But today I am sword fighting.
She always walks to work. Today she is taking the bus.
We usually stay home. Now we are going to a party.

grammar.title: Giving reasons with because
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) because تعني «لأنّ» وتربط النتيجة بالسبب.
٢) النتيجة + because + السبب: I am happy because it is sunny.
٣) بعد because نضع جملة كاملة فيها فاعل وفعل.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Because gives a reason.
2) Result + because + reason: I am happy because it is sunny.
3) After because, use a full sentence with a subject and verb.
examples: I am not bored because there is a party.
She is tired because she works a lot.
We are here because it's his birthday.
